response.what_it_is: Bright treadle sewing machine with wooden cabinet and iron stand
hidden_risks: internal mechanical wear or rust from long disuse
missing shuttle, bobbin case, or needle
broken or missing treadle drive belt
woodwork condition or structural stability of the cabinet
response.best_proof: A video demonstrating smooth handwheel rotation and test-stitching fabric, or close-ups of the internal bobbin and shuttle area.
response.failure_mode: Overvaluing the machine by trusting the seller's claim that it works perfectly without verifying internal mechanical condition, timing, or missing shuttle/bobbin components.
